sentences: Related machines differ by speed, while each job's processing requirement scales consistently across machines.
Precedence constraints additionally require some jobs to finish before others can start.
The textbook asks for a constant-factor approximation for scheduling such dependent work.
An algorithm must exploit faster machines without delaying the chains of jobs that unlock later parallelism.
The saved summary does not name the objective or preemption convention, so it does not silently assume every related-machine precedence problem shares one constant-approximation target.
